title: एकसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Krishna tells Yudhishthira that he has heard both Sanjaya and him and knows Duryodhana's mind: he will not give up the kingdom while he lives. He recalls the Kauravas' cruelties and says that the kings scorned Duryodhana for them, and that war is inevitable, though he will still try for peace.
summary.kn: ಸಂಜಯನನ್ನೂ ನಿನ್ನನ್ನೂ ಕೇಳಿದ್ದೇನೆ, ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಬಲ್ಲೆ, ಬದುಕಿರುವವರೆಗೆ ಅವನು ರಾಜ್ಯ ಬಿಡನು ಎಂದು ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕೌರವರ ಕ್ರೌರ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನೆದು, ಅವುಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ರಾಜರು ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನನ್ನು ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಿದರು, ಯುದ್ಧ ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯ, ಆದರೂ ಶಾಂತಿಗೆ ಯತ್ನಿಸುವೆ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: श्रीकृष्ण युधिष्ठिर से कहते हैं कि उन्होंने सञ्जय और उन्हें दोनों को सुना है और दुर्योधन का मन जानते हैं: जीते जी वह राज्य नहीं छोड़ेगा। वे कौरवों की क्रूरताएँ याद कर कहते हैं कि उनके कारण राजाओं ने दुर्योधन का तिरस्कार किया, और युद्ध अनिवार्य है, फिर भी वे शान्ति का प्रयास करेंगे।
summary.te: సంజయుని, నిన్నూ విన్నానని, దుర్యోధనుని మనసు తెలుసని, బ్రతికి ఉండగా అతడు రాజ్యం వదలడని శ్రీకృష్ణుడు యుధిష్ఠిరునికి చెబుతాడు. కౌరవుల క్రౌర్యాలను గుర్తుచేసి, వాటి వల్ల రాజులు దుర్యోధనుని తిరస్కరించారని, యుద్ధం అనివార్యమని, అయినా శాంతికి ప్రయత్నిస్తానని అంటాడు.
summary.ta: ஸஞ்ஜயனையும் உம்மையும் கேட்டேன், துரியோதனனின் மனம் அறிவேன், உயிருடன் இருக்கும் வரை அவன் அரசை விட மாட்டான் என்று ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் யுதிஷ்டிரரிடம் சொல்கிறார். கௌரவர்களின் கொடுமைகளை நினைவுகூர்ந்து, அவற்றுக்காக மன்னர்கள் துரியோதனனை இகழ்ந்தார்கள், போர் தவிர்க்க முடியாதது, இருந்தும் அமைதிக்கு முயல்வேன் என்கிறார்.
summary.ml: സഞ്ജയന്റെയും തന്റെയും വാക്കുകൾ കേട്ടു, ദുര്യോധനന്റെ മനസ്സ് താൻ മനസ്സിലാക്കിയെന്ന് കൃഷ്ണൻ യുധിഷ്ഠിരനോട് പറയുന്നു: ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുവോളം അവൻ രാജ്യം വിട്ടുകൊടുക്കില്ല. കൗരവരുടെ ക്രൂരതകൾ ഓർമ്മിക്കുന്ന അദ്ദേഹം, അവർക്കുവേണ്ടി രാജാക്കന്മാർ ദുര്യോധനനെ പരിഹസിച്ചുവെന്ന് പറയുന്നു; യുദ്ധം ഒഴിവാക്കാനാവില്ലെങ്കിലും സമാധാനത്തിനായി ശ്രമിക്കുമെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.71; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: भगवानुवाच

meaning.en: The Blessed Lord said:

verses.text:
संजयस्य श्रुतं वाक्यं भवतश्च श्रुतं मया ।
सर्वं जानाम्यभिप्रायं तेषां च भवतश्च यः ॥

meaning.en: Krishna to Yudhishthira: I have heard Sanjaya's message and I have heard yours. I understand the intent of both sides, theirs and yours.

verses.text:
तव धर्माश्रिता बुद्धिस्तेषां वैराश्रिता मतिः ।
यदयुद्धेन लभ्येत तत्ते बहुमतं भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: Your mind rests on dharma; theirs rests on enmity. You would be glad to gain your share without a war.

verses.text:
न च तन्नैष्ठिकं कर्म क्षत्रियस्य विशां पते ।
आहुराश्रमिणः सर्वे यद्भैक्षं क्षत्रियश्चरेत् ॥

meaning.en: But, lord of men, that is not the final duty of a kshatriya; all the orders of life say that a kshatriya should not live on alms.

verses.text:
जयो वधो वा संग्रामे धात्रा दिष्टः सनातनः ।
स्वधर्मः क्षत्रियस्यैष कार्पण्यं न प्रशस्यते ॥

meaning.en: Victory or death in battle is the eternal course the Creator ordained; this is the kshatriya's own dharma, and meek pity is not praised.

verses.text:
न हि कार्पण्यमास्थाय शक्या वृत्तिर्युधिष्ठिर ।
विक्रमस्व महाबाहो जहि शत्रूनरिंदम ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira, one cannot live by wretchedness. Mighty-armed tamer of foes, show your valor and strike down your enemies.

verses.text:
अतिगृद्धाः कृतस्नेहा दीर्घकालं सहोषिताः ।
कृतमित्राः कृतबला धार्तराष्ट्राः परंतप ॥

meaning.en: Scorcher of foes, the sons of Dhritarashtra are greedy, deeply attached to their gains, long settled together, and they have made allies and gathered strength.

verses.text:
न पर्यायोऽस्ति यत्साम्यं त्वयि कुर्युर्विशां पते ।
बलवत्तां हि मन्यन्ते भीष्मद्रोणकृपादिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Lord of the people, they will never treat you as equals in turn, for they think themselves stronger with Bhishma, Drona, Kripa and the rest.

verses.text:
यावच्च मार्दवेनैतान्राजन्नुपचरिष्यसि ।
तावदेते हरिष्यन्ति तव राज्यमरिंदम ॥

meaning.en: King, as long as you deal gently with them, so long will they go on seizing your kingdom.

verses.text:
नानुक्रोशान्न कार्पण्यान्न च धर्मार्थकारणात् ।
अलं कर्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रास्तव काममरिंदम ॥

meaning.en: Neither from compassion, nor from pity, nor for the sake of dharma or profit will the Dhartarashtras grant what you desire.

verses.text:
एतदेव निमित्तं ते पाण्डवास्तु यथा त्वयि ।
नान्वतप्यन्त कौपीनं तावत्कृत्वापि दुष्करम् ॥

meaning.en: This is why the Pandavas, though they bore even the hardest of things for you, felt no remorse for the wrong they had done.

verses.text:
पितामहस्य द्रोणस्य विदुरस्य च धीमतः ।
पश्यतां कुरुमुख्यानां सर्वेषामेव तत्त्वतः ॥

meaning.en: In the very sight of the grandsire Bhishma, Drona, wise Vidura and all the chief Kurus, it was truly done.

verses.text:
दानशीलं मृदुं दान्तं धर्मकाममनुव्रतम् ।
यत्त्वामुपधिना राजन्द्यूतेनावञ्चयत्तदा ।
न चापत्रपते पापो नृशंसस्तेन कर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: You were generous, gentle, self-controlled and devoted to dharma and desire, and that wicked, cruel man cheated you by a trick at dice; even now he feels no shame for that deed.

verses.text:
तथाशीलसमाचारे राजन्मा प्रणयं कृथाः ।
वध्यास्ते सर्वलोकस्य किं पुनस्तव भारत ॥

meaning.en: King, do not show affection to a man of such character and conduct; all the world would kill him, how much more you, descendant of Bharata.

verses.text:
वाग्भिस्त्वप्रतिरूपाभिरतुदत्सकनीयसम् ।
श्लाघमानः प्रहृष्टः सन्भाषते भ्रातृभिः सह ॥

meaning.en: With unseemly words he tormented the younger brothers, and boasting gleefully he talked on with his brothers.

verses.text:
एतावत्पाण्डवानां हि नास्ति किंचिदिह स्वकम् ।
नामधेयं च गोत्रं च तदप्येषां न शिष्यते ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas have nothing here that is truly their own; not even their name and lineage is left to them.

verses.text:
कालेन महता चैषां भविष्यति पराभवः ।
प्रकृतिं ते भजिष्यन्ति नष्टप्रकृतयो जनाः ॥

meaning.en: After a long time defeat will come to them; people who have lost their true nature will again take refuge in their own.

verses.text:
एताश्चान्याश्च परुषा वाचः स समुदीरयन् ।
श्लाघते ज्ञातिमध्ये स्म त्वयि प्रव्रजिते वनम् ॥

meaning.en: These and other harsh words he spoke, and he boasted among his kinsmen when you had gone to the forest.

verses.text:
ये तत्रासन्समानीतास्ते दृष्ट्वा त्वामनागसम् ।
अश्रुकण्ठा रुदन्तश्च सभायामासते तदा ॥

meaning.en: Those who had been gathered there saw you blameless, and sat in the hall with tears choking their throats, weeping.

verses.text:
न चैनमभ्यनन्दंस्ते राजानो ब्राह्मणैः सह ।
सर्वे दुर्योधनं तत्र निन्दन्ति स्म सभासदः ॥

meaning.en: Neither the kings nor the brahmanas welcomed him; all the members of the assembly there censured Duryodhana.

verses.text:
कुलीनस्य च या निन्दा वधश्चामित्रकर्शन ।
महागुणो वधो राजन्न तु निन्दा कुजीविका ॥

meaning.en: Destroyer of enemies, for a man of good family, disgrace is as bad as death; but death is of great merit, whereas a life of disgrace is a wretched livelihood.

verses.text:
तदैव निहतो राजन्यदैव निरपत्रपः ।
निन्दितश्च महाराज पृथिव्यां सर्वराजसु ॥

meaning.en: King, he was slain at the very moment he became shameless and was condemned by all the kings of the earth.

verses.text:
ईषत्कार्यो वधस्तस्य यस्य चारित्रमीदृशम् ।
प्रस्कम्भनप्रतिस्तब्धश्छिन्नमूल इव द्रुमः ॥

meaning.en: The killing of one with such conduct is a light task; he is like a tree propped up, with its root already cut.

verses.text:
वध्यः सर्प इवानार्यः सर्वलोकस्य दुर्मतिः ।
जह्येनं त्वममित्रघ्न मा राजन्विचिकित्सिथाः ॥

meaning.en: Like a snake, the ignoble, evil-minded man deserves death at the hands of all the world. Slay him, destroyer of foes; do not hesitate, king.

verses.text:
सर्वथा त्वत्क्षमं चैतद्रोचते च ममानघ ।
यत्त्वं पितरि भीष्मे च प्रणिपातं समाचरेः ॥

meaning.en: Sinless one, I wholly approve that you should bow humbly to your father figure Bhishma; it suits you.

verses.text:
अहं तु सर्वलोकस्य गत्वा छेत्स्यामि संशयम् ।
येषामस्ति द्विधाभावो राजन्दुर्योधनं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: But I shall go and cut away the doubts of all the world, of those who are of two minds about Duryodhana.

verses.text:
मध्ये राज्ञामहं तत्र प्रातिपौरुषिकान्गुणान् ।
तव संकीर्तयिष्यामि ये च तस्य व्यतिक्रमाः ॥

meaning.en: There among the kings I shall proclaim your qualities, each in turn, and his transgressions.

verses.text:
ब्रुवतस्तत्र मे वाक्यं धर्मार्थसहितं हितम् ।
निशम्य पार्थिवाः सर्वे नानाजनपदेश्वराः ॥

meaning.en: When they hear my words, beneficial and full of dharma and profit, all the kings, lords of many countries,

verses.text:
त्वयि संप्रतिपत्स्यन्ते धर्मात्मा सत्यवागिति ।
तस्मिंश्चाधिगमिष्यन्ति यथा लोभादवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: will accept that you are righteous and truthful, and will learn how he acted out of greed.

verses.text:
गर्हयिष्यामि चैवैनं पौरजानपदेष्वपि ।
वृद्धबालानुपादाय चातुर्वर्ण्यसमागमे ॥

meaning.en: I shall also denounce him before townsfolk and country people, taking elders and children, in an assembly of all four classes.

verses.text:
शमं चेद्याचमानस्त्वं न धर्मं तत्र लप्स्यसे ।
कुरून्विगर्हयिष्यन्ति धृतराष्ट्रं च पार्थिवाः ॥

meaning.en: If, when you plead for peace, you gain no justice there, the kings will condemn the Kurus and Dhritarashtra.

verses.text:
तस्मिँल्लोकपरित्यक्ते किं कार्यमवशिष्यते ।
हते दुर्योधने राजन्यदन्यत्क्रियतामिति ॥

meaning.en: When he is abandoned by the world, what task remains, king, except that he be slain and something else be done.

verses.text:
यात्वा चाहं कुरून्सर्वान्युष्मदर्थमहापयन् ।
यतिष्ये प्रशमं कर्तुं लक्षयिष्ये च चेष्टितम् ॥

meaning.en: I shall go to all the Kurus, doing no harm to your cause, try to bring about peace and observe their conduct.

verses.text:
कौरवाणां प्रवृत्तिं च गत्वा युद्धाधिकारिकाम् ।
निशाम्य विनिवर्तिष्ये जयाय तव भारत ॥

meaning.en: Descendant of Bharata, I shall go, learn the Kauravas' course toward war, and return for your victory.

verses.text:
सर्वथा युद्धमेवाहमाशंसामि परैः सह ।
निमित्तानि हि सर्वाणि तथा प्रादुर्भवन्ति मे ॥

meaning.en: In every way I expect war with the enemy, for all the omens appear before me.

verses.text:
मृगाः शकुन्ताश्च वदन्ति घोरं
हस्त्यश्वमुख्येषु निशामुखेषु ।
घोराणि रूपाणि तथैव चाग्नि-
र्वर्णान्बहून्पुष्यति घोररूपान् ।
मनुष्यलोकक्षपणोऽथ घोरो
नो चेदनुप्राप्त इहान्तकः स्यात् ॥

meaning.en: Beasts and birds cry dreadfully near the leading elephants and horses at nightfall; fire takes dreadful shapes and nourishes many fearsome colors. Truly a dread destroyer of the human world, Death himself, has arrived.

verses.text:
शस्त्राणि पत्रं कवचान्रथांश्च
नागान्ध्वजांश्च प्रतिपादयित्वा ।
योधाश्च सर्वे कृतनिश्रमास्ते
भवन्तु हस्त्यश्वरथेषु यत्ताः ।
सांग्रामिकं ते यदुपार्जनीयं
सर्वं समग्रं कुरु तन्नरेन्द्र ॥

meaning.en: Supply weapons, leaves of armor, mail, chariots, elephants and banners; let all the warriors, rested, be ready with their elephants, horses and chariots. King, make complete all that must be gathered for battle.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनो न ह्यलमद्य दातुं
जीवंस्तवैतन्नृपते कथंचित् ।
यत्ते पुरस्तादभवत्समृद्धं
द्यूते हृतं पाण्डवमुख्य राज्यम् ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana, while he lives, will never give you back by any means what was yours before, the prosperous kingdom of the Pandavas taken at dice.
